index.html.title: BuildingWebViewer · 三维数据工具箱 / 3D Data Workspace
index.html.description: 在浏览器中查看 LOD 建筑模型、OBJ 线框、点云与三维高斯泼溅，也可绘制和修订点云。数据仅在本机处理。Browser-based LOD mesh, wireframe, point cloud and Gaussian splatting viewers, plus point-cloud creation and editing. Files stay on your device.

lod.html.title: LOD 模型查看器 / LOD Model Viewer · BuildingWebViewer
lod.html.description: 本地 OBJ 建筑模型查看器：多栋陈列、实体与线框、色带、相机书签和项目文件管理。Local OBJ mesh viewer with multiple buildings, solid and wireframe display, palettes, camera bookmarks and project folders.

wireframe.html.title: 线框查看器 / Wireframe Viewer · BuildingWebViewer
wireframe.html.description: 通用 OBJ 线框查看器：按目录分组、点云叠加、最多三个面板对比与相机同步。General OBJ wireframe viewer with folder groups, point cloud overlays, up to three comparison panes and synchronized cameras.

pointcloud.html.title: 点云查看器 / Point Cloud Viewer · BuildingWebViewer
pointcloud.html.description: 本地点云查看与处理：TXT、XYZ、CSV、PTS、PLY、PCD，多文件叠加、RGB/HSV、属性映射、法向量计算与合并导出。Local point cloud viewing and processing: multi-file overlays, RGB/HSV, attribute mapping, normals and merged export.

gaussian.html.title: 高斯泼溅查看器 / Gaussian Splatting Viewer · BuildingWebViewer
gaussian.html.description: 在浏览器中查看 3D Gaussian Splatting 的二进制 PLY：正交泼溅、球谐颜色、尺度与训练机位。文件只在本机处理。Local 3D Gaussian Splatting viewer for binary PLY, with spherical harmonics, scale and training-camera directions.

generate.html.title: 点云创作与修订 / Point Cloud Studio · BuildingWebViewer
generate.html.description: 本地创建和修订点云：三维画笔、框选与套索、可恢复删除、裁剪、属性保留及项目保存。Create and refine point clouds locally with 3D drawing, rectangle/lasso selection, reversible deletion, cropping and editable projects.
